column1: # Arch package name -> Gentoo overlay location.
# A package ships a Gentoo ebuild iff it is listed here AND
# table to reconcile ebuilds with the PKGBUILDs in the omarchy-pkgs/ submodule.
# Gentoo package names drop Arch-isms where Gentoo convention is firm:
# -git suffixes (sources are pinned tarballs, not live git)
# names that merely repeat the category
# elephant-* are many-to-one: one merged ebuild ships the daemon
# and every provider plugin (same tag, same source).
